items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He joined us in '37... that's when Harry Edison came in in 1938

ctx.x: You don't know whose place he took?

Well, you see there was a whole lot of shuffling going on because remember we had a little fellow by the name of Bobby Moore, a little 17-year-old wonder, who was the forerunner of Dizzy Gillespie. He joined us in '37. He was a kid and he went to get an operation on his teeth and before he could heal well - we didn't have time to wait on him to heal - that's when Harry Edison came in in 1938. But Shad, when we did the thing at Randall's Island - that was the big festival that they had at Randall's Island with…
When did Dickie come in now -
